theme.name: Awadhi Marigold Elegance
theme.why: This theme honours traditional Awadhi hospitality while keeping decor simple, cheerful, and budget-friendly for a large family gathering.

decor.title: Marigold and Mango Leaf Garlands
decor.detail: Drape fresh marigold flowers and mango leaves along the venue entrance and stage to create a vibrant, traditional look without heavy costs.

decor.title: Brass Diya Lighting Accent
decor.detail: Set up brass lamps and flower-filled urlis along step-free pathways to safely illuminate the venue for evening festivities.

decor.title: Fabric Canopy Stage Background
decor.detail: Use flowing orange and yellow dupattas draped over a basic frame to form an elegant backdrop for photos and ceremonies.

menu.title: Paneer Pasanda
menu.detail: Rich, tender cottage cheese slices stuffed with nuts and cooked in a mild, aromatic gravy that pleases all generations.

menu.title: Awadhi Veg Biryani
menu.detail: Fragrant basmati rice layered with seasonal vegetables and mild spices, cooked dum-style for an authentic regional taste.

menu.title: Galouti Kebab-Style Tikki
menu.detail: Melt-in-your-mouth spiced yam and chana dal patties, served with mint chutney as a delicious vegetarian appetizer.

menu.title: Zafrani Kheer
menu.detail: A classic slow-cooked rice pudding infused with saffron and cardamom, offering a comforting traditional dessert.

activities.title: Sangeet and Antakshari Fusion
activities.detail: A lively yet relaxing musical game combining classic hits and family performances, ensuring grandparents can participate comfortably.

activities.title: Interactive Mehndi Station
activities.detail: A shaded seating corner with skilled artists applying quick, traditional henna designs for guests of all ages.

activities.title: Family Blessing Tree
activities.detail: A setup where guests write heart-felt wishes on cards and hang them on a decorative wooden branch display.

touch.title: Elder Comfort Lounge
touch.detail: A dedicated lounge area near the main stage equipped with cushioned seating, warm shawls, and easy accessibility for comfortable viewing.
